title: Pin critical validation workflows to explicit Ubuntu 24.04 runners

phases.objective: Replace the mutable ubuntu-latest alias with the empirically allocatable ubuntu-24.04 label in the eleven load-bearing validation workflows while retiring the duplicated write-capable Spec 014 collector from the pull-request Control Plane Guard and preserving the dedicated readback workflow.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions hosted workflow scheduler and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request changes one or more of the eleven load-bearing validation workflows.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every allowlisted job requests ubuntu-24.04, no allowlisted job requests ubuntu-latest, pull-request validation remains read-only, and the Spec 014 readback collector exists only in its dedicated workflow.
steps: Read the eleven allowlisted workflow definitions from the exact candidate tree.
Require ubuntu-24.04 for every allowlisted workflow job.
Reject any remaining ubuntu-latest label in the allowlist.
Verify E2E reference integrity, Fanout reporting, Supervisor assurance, and Hostinger Control Plane validation remain read-only on pull requests.
Verify Runtime Startup evidence and Branch Test Diagnostic jobs request the explicit runner label.
Verify the known-good shared canary remains pinned to ubuntu-24.04.
Require the Spec 014 runtime-evidence collector and its issue-comment write permission to remain owned by the dedicated readback workflow, not the permanent Control Plane Guard.
Publish no repository, provider, database, deployment, credential, or external runtime mutation.
assertions: Exactly eleven load-bearing workflows are governed by the runner-label allowlist.
Every allowlisted workflow requests ubuntu-24.04 and none requests ubuntu-latest.
The patch preserves CI and Recovery pull-request stale-run cancellation from current main.
Pull-request validation workflows contain no git push or write API command.
Hostinger Storage Control Plane Guard contains no branch-specific readback carrier, issue write permission, or embedded runtime-evidence collector.
The dedicated Spec 014 readback workflow retains its exact issue and pull-request fallback contracts without granting Apply, provider, database, or credential authority.
Runtime Startup evidence and Branch Diagnostic retain their original triggers, commands, artifacts, and concurrency semantics.
No Work Map writer is dispatched and no generated Work Map is manually edited by this source candidate.
No Production, provider, credential, SQL, Migration Apply, database, protected-ref, force-push, deployment, restart, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Confirm the exact candidate's load-bearing jobs obtain first-step timestamps and terminal results on the explicit hosted runner label.
Reject reintroduction of ubuntu-latest or a write-capable branch-specific collector into the governed load-bearing pull-request workflows.
Compare hosted-runner allocation evidence without invoking a provider or Production action.
This repository scheduling and workflow-governance change performs no deployment or Production mutation.
